if bonus == True:
Maki and I decide to spend the night together like any two sexually confident, mature adults would- by watching porn bloopers and ranking the actors involved on a scale of one to ten.
lines.zh: Maki 和我决定像两个性方面很自信的成熟大人那样过一晚——看色情片的花絮，然后给里面的演员按一到十分打分。

lines.en: As it turns out, we have surprisingly similar tastes and wind up within one or two points of each other with virtually every choice we make.
lines.zh: 结果我们的口味意外地接近，几乎每一次打分都只差一两分。

lines.en: Of course, you can only watch porn bloopers for so long before they get exhausting- so we eventually move to watching real porn and...yeah.
lines.zh: 当然，花絮看久了也会腻——于是我们最后改看真正的色情片，然后……嗯。

lines.en: I guess that's just the kind of relationship I have with Maki now.
lines.zh: 我跟 Maki 现在大概就是这种关系。

lines.en: And while it's entirely different from the one I have with Makoto (Like, literally {i}entirely{/i} different) it's definitely one that I enjoy.
lines.zh: 虽然这和我跟 Makoto 的关系完全不同（真的是{i}完全{/i}不同），但这确实是我喜欢的一种。

lines.en: I know plenty of openly sexual people now, but none able to remain so casual about it without blushing or nervously offering me a handjob.
lines.zh: 我现在认识不少对性毫不掩饰的人，但没有一个能像她这样坦然随意，既不脸红，也不紧张地提出要帮我打手枪。

lines.en: Now, don't get me wrong- nervous handjobs are possibly the best type of handjob you can get. But there's just something about a woman being so unintimidated by sex that it's...weirdly refreshing.
lines.zh: 别误会——紧张的打手枪大概是最好的那种。但一个女人对性这么毫无畏惧，就是有种……说不出的清爽。

lines.en: But, then again, if you start to view Maki's outlook on all things sexual as more of a desensitization thing rather than a quirky personality trait, it's kind of sad.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果你把 Maki 对性的那套看法理解成一种脱敏，而不是古怪的性格特质，那其实有点悲哀。

lines.en: I do hope that whatever it was that managed to get her to the point she's at today (Likely the overconsumption of pornography) didn't damage her beyond repair.
lines.zh: 我真心希望，让她变成今天这样的那些东西（大概就是看了太多色情片）没有把她毁到无法修复。

lines.en: Thankfully, the smile on her face as we watch a tiny blonde girl get split in half by a penis nearly half of her total size forces me to realize that this is...just what makes her happy.
lines.zh: 幸好，当我们看着一个娇小的金发女孩被一根几乎有她半个身子大的阴茎劈成两半时，她脸上的笑让我明白——这就是让她快乐的东西。

lines.en: As strange as that may be...
lines.zh: 哪怕这有多奇怪……

lines.en: else:
Maki and I decide to spend the night together like any two adult humans beings would- by eating Fig Newtons and watching the news.
lines.zh: Maki 和我决定像两个成年人类那样过一晚——吃 Fig Newtons 饼干，看新闻。

Watching so many people have sex works up an appetite for the two of us and we ultimately wind up going out to dinner at some restaurant around the corner from my house.
lines.zh: 看那么多人做爱把我们都看饿了，最后我们出门，在我家拐角那家餐馆吃了晚饭。

lines.en: After that, we split apart and decide to call it a night.
lines.zh: 之后我们分开，就此结束这一天。

lines.en: And even though we did nothing but watch some of the lewdest videos I have ever seen and wash them down with pasta, I feel like I got a lot closer to Maki.
lines.zh: 虽然我们除了看那些我看过最下流的视频、再用意面把它们冲下去之外什么都没做，我还是觉得自己跟 Maki 近了很多。

lines.en: I've known it for a while, but she's a lot more than just...Makoto's mom.
lines.zh: 我早就知道，她远不只是……Makoto 的妈妈。

lines.en: Sure, her interests aren't exactly commonplace or...widely accepted or...even {i}appropriate{/i} by any stretch of the imagination-
lines.zh: 当然，她的兴趣算不上常见，也算不上……被广泛接受，更谈不上……{i}得体{/i}——

lines.en: But at least she's passionate about something.
lines.zh: 但至少她对某件事充满热情。

lines.en: That's more than a lot of people can say.
lines.zh: 这一点就比很多人都强。

lines.en: That's more than {i}I{/i} can say.
lines.zh: 也比{i}我{/i}强。

lines.en: else:
Boy, do I love Fig Newtons.
lines.zh: 天啊，我真是太爱 Fig Newtons 了。
